name: week
title: Treasury this week
subtitle: Cash, the 13 weeks ahead and what needs a decision. Rendered by npm run view.

sections.title: Needs a decision
sections.note: Stale balances, late receipts, policy breaches, covenants and maturities.
sections.sql: select issue, record, owner, due from attention_items order by due nulls first, record

sections.title: Cash position
sections.sql: select entity, currency, accounts, balance_cents as balance_cents, base_cents as in_base_cents, oldest_days as oldest_balance_days from (select entity, currency, count(*)::integer accounts, sum(balance_cents)::bigint balance_cents, sum(base_cents)::bigint base_cents, max(days_old) oldest_days from account_position group by entity, currency) p order by entity, currency

sections.title: 13-week forecast (base currency)
sections.note: Overdue expected flows sit in week 0 until they are settled, moved or cancelled.
sections.sql: select week, week_start, opening_cents, in_cents, out_cents, closing_cents, (closing_cents - floor_cents)::bigint over_floor_cents from forecast_weeks order by week

name: fx
title: FX cover against policy
subtitle: Exposures, hedges and the board's bands

sections.title: Cover by band
sections.sql: select currency, direction, months_from, months_to, exposure_cents, hedged_cents, cover_pct, min_pct, max_pct, status from fx_cover_status order by currency, direction, months_from

sections.title: Open hedges
sections.sql: select h.code, h.counterparty, h.currency, h.direction, h.notional_cents, h.contract_rate, r.base_per_unit as spot_rate, h.settles_on, h.designated, h.designation_ref from hedges h left join rates_latest r on r.currency = h.currency where h.status = 'open' order by h.settles_on

sections.title: Facilities
sections.sql: select code, entity, lender, kind, currency, limit_cents, drawn_cents, headroom_cents, maturity_on, days_to_maturity, review_on from facility_status order by maturity_on

sections.title: Covenants
sections.sql: select code, name, facility, test, threshold, value, passed, headroom_pct, certificate_due_on, certificate_sent_on, next_test_on from covenant_status order by facility, code

sections.title: Bank counterparty exposure
sections.sql: select bank, rating, deposits_cents, limit_cents, (limit_cents - deposits_cents)::bigint spare_cents from counterparty_exposure order by deposits_cents desc
